title: Observed Transaction Record (docs/30)
description: One observed HTTP/TLS transaction as emitted by a proxy/TLS terminator log adapter. Carries observable behavior only. Self-declared fields (User-Agent text) are captured as raw material but never trusted; the engine uses construction behavior (ordering, structure, correctness). Absent optional fields mean the terminator did not observe that material — absence is recorded, never guessed.

client_ref.description: Opaque client identity at the terminator (e.g. 'ip:port' or connection id). Pseudonymized to a requester handle (rh--) before storage; the raw ref is not persisted by the attribution engine.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the transaction.

session_epoch.description: Operator-controlled epoch bucket for probe-order draws (docs/29). Optional; defaults to the store's policy epoch.

header_order.description: P1: request header names in exact emission order (P1:header_order, P1:header_set).

accept_language.description: P2: raw Accept-Language value (used only for structural coherence, not content).

tls_ja4.description: P3: JA4-family digest of the client hello, captured passively at the TLS terminator.

cache_behavior.description: P4: observed conditional-request correctness class on a versioned asset.

challenge_body_key_order.description: P5: key order the client used when serializing the canonical-JSON challenge response.

range_fallback.description: P6: observed Range/Accept-Encoding fallback behavior class.
